abstract: Mature benign cystic teratomas, or dermoid cysts, usually arise in the ovary. They can, however, occur at other sites, including the mediastinum. Malignant change within dermoid cysts is a rare but recognized complication, occurring in 1%-2% of cases. A case of malignant change within a mediastinal dermoid cyst occurring 19 years after initial presentation is described.
abstract_ja: 成熟良性嚢胞性奇形腫（類皮嚢腫）は通常卵巣に生じるが、縦隔などの他部位にも発生しうる。類皮嚢腫内の悪性転化は稀ではあるが認められており、発生頻度は1〜2%とされる。初診から19年後に縦隔類皮嚢腫の悪性転化を認めた症例を報告する。
